annotation.bound_parties_text: The Jiangsu Decision on promoting the Internet of Vehicles and intelligent connected vehicles binds provincial and local people's governments and departments, related enterprises (including those conducting road testing, demonstration and commercial application), and producers and sellers of intelligent connected vehicle products.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: 智能网联汽车产品生产者、销售者应当按照法律、法规、规章和国家其他有关规定，对其生产、销售的产品质量负责
annotation.dates_quote: 十九、本决定自 2024 年 1 月 1 日起施行。
annotation.robot_provision_quote: （2023年11月29日江苏省第十四届人民代表大会常务委员会第六次会议通过）
